body_lead: BENGALURU: To familiarise government employees with emerging technologies, the Karnataka government has revised the syllabus of the Computer Literacy Test, making artificial intelligence (AI) and cyber security key components. This is to ensure safer and more secure digital operations and to enable faster and more efficient functioning of government offices. The test is conducted under the Karnataka Civil Services (Computer Literacy Test) Rules, 2012.
